name: Futa Majo
source:
There is a Private Magic School located in the depths of an unknown forest. The students are descendants of the first wave of wizards that flew from their world 400 years ago, driven away by the demon lord.
Naoya studies there surrounded by twin sister students. They say that Naoya is the container who now inherits the soul of the legendary Devil. Both white and black witches start a battle over his powers. At the same time, Naoya uses his sudden magic power to do mischievous things to the girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一片不知名的森林深处，有一所私立魔法学校。这些学生是400年前被恶魔领主赶走的第一波巫师的后裔。
直哉在那里学习，周围都是双胞胎姐妹学生。他们说，直哉是现在继承了传说中的恶魔灵魂的容器。白人和黑人女巫都开始争夺他的力量。与此同时，直哉利用突然出现的魔力对女孩们做出恶作剧。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
